f.title: Complete the mandatory sections of the DDA suspected ADR reporting form
f.statement: The sections marked with an asterisk are mandatory fields of the DDA suspected ADR reporting form: A. Patient information, B. Suspected adverse reaction, C. Suspected medication(s) and D. Reporter details.

rows.quote: * Mandatory Fields for suspected ADR Reporting Form
rows.review_note: Review: the asterisk marks sections A-D as mandatory; the quote is the legend. Double-check: form-level data requirement; actor inferred (form is for all reporters, pharmaceutical company is a listed source).

f.title: Record patient identification and characteristics on the ADR form
f.statement: Section A (mandatory) captures patient name, age at onset or date of birth, gender, pregnancy and lactation status, weight (kg) and height (cm), together with the hospital registration/IPD/OPD/CR number.

rows.actor: Reporter submitting a suspected ADR report to DDA (including pharmaceutical companies)
rows.review_note: Review: individual fields listed from the form; only the section header carries the mandatory marker. Double-check: confidence 80, field-level obligation not explicit.

f.title: Describe the suspected reaction with dates, seriousness and outcome
f.statement: Section B (mandatory) captures reaction onset and end dates and times, duration, management, relevant investigations, medical/drug history, seriousness (death with date, life threatening, hospitalisation initial/prolonged, congenital anomaly, disability, other medically important) and outcome (recovered, recovering, not recovered, fatal, recovered with sequelae, unknown).

rows.actor: Reporter submitting a suspected ADR report to DDA (including pharmaceutical companies)
rows.review_note: Review: fields listed from the form. Double-check: as row 2.

f.title: Give suspected medication details, action taken, rechallenge and concomitant drugs
f.statement: Section C (mandatory) captures for each suspected medication the brand/generic name, manufacturer, batch/lot number, expiry date, dose, route, frequency, therapy start and stop dates, indication and whether causality assessment was performed; it also records action taken (withdrawn, dose increased/reduced/not changed), whether the reaction reappeared on reintroduction, concomitant products including self-medication and herbal remedies, and whether a product quality issue (including falsification) is suspected.

rows.actor: Reporter submitting a suspected ADR report to DDA (including pharmaceutical companies)
rows.review_note: Review: fields listed from the form. Double-check: as row 2.

f.title: Provide reporter details and date of report; flag initial or follow-up
f.statement: Section D (mandatory) captures reporter name and address, qualification, organisation, email, contact number, signature and date of report; the form also indicates whether the case is initial or follow-up and the report type (spontaneous, study, other).
